summary: Iran's IRGC launched ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan targeting CENTCOM headquarters, marking the first Iranian missile strike on US forces since Trump paused strikes. Simultaneously, US and Saudi forces struck PMU bases across Iraq, causing casualties. Israel intensified Gaza operations, killing a Nukhba commander and discovering buried long-range rockets.
key_points: IRGC Aerospace Force fired several ballistic missiles at US air base and CENTCOM headquarters in Jordan in response to US aggressive actions. (Source: @presstv/200676)
US and Saudi airstrikes hit official PMU bases in Nineveh, Wasit, and Basra provinces, resulting in martyrs, injuries, and material damage. (Source: @kianmeli1/90203)
IDF eliminated Nukhba company commander Muhammad Hilal Muhammad Aslam in Khan Younis, who led a cell that kidnapped Israelis on October 7. (Source: @New_security8200/203037)
Israeli troops uncovered buried rockets in northern Gaza capable of reaching central Israel; security establishment estimates Hamas retains more such rockets. (Source: @New_security8200/203042)
Defense Minister Katz ordered IDF to prepare seizure of another refugee camp per the Jenin/Tulkarem model of permanent military presence. (Source: @New_security8200/203031)
Hezbollah-affiliated Islamic Health Organization operates in pilot village Zutar al-Arabiya in south Lebanon, previously moving operatives and arms via ambulances. (Source: @inon_yttach/9704)
Trump threatened to strike Iran's underground Fordow facility, bridges, and power plants if nuclear deal fails, claiming ability to destroy all power plants in one day. (Source: @VahidOnline/77568)
Crude oil prices surged 4.4% following Iran's missile strike on US base in Jordan. (Source: @presstv/200665)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's IRGC launched ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan targeting CENTCOM headquarters, marking the first Iranian missile strike on US forces since Trump paused strikes. Simultaneously, US and Saudi forces struck PMU bases across Iraq, causing casualties. Israel intensified Gaza operations, killing a Nukhba commander and discovering buried long-range rockets.

points: IRGC Aerospace Force claimed responsibility for firing several ballistic missiles at a US air base and CENTCOM headquarters in Jordan, stating the attack responds to aggressive US military actions and warning resistance will continue until threats stop. (Source: @presstv/200676)
A US official confirmed Iran launched ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan, the first such Iranian strike since Trump paused attacks on Iran Friday. (Source: @inon_yttach/9715)
Reports indicate Iran fired 5 ballistic missiles at Jordan, with 10 Patriot missiles used for interception. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5837)

Trump threatened to strike Iran's underground Fordow facility, bridges, and all power plants within one day if nuclear deal fails, saying 91 million Iranians would lose electricity. (Source: @VahidOnline/77568)

A senior US official told Reuters Iran is making excessive demands regarding the Strait of Hormuz, which Oman, US, and international community reject; current talks are for coordination only, not toll collection. (Source: @asafroz/52025)
Netanyahu described his meeting with Trump as excellent, with full partnership and shared goal that Iran must not obtain nuclear weapons, by agreement or otherwise. (Source: @New_security8200/203039)

IDF killed Nukhba company commander Muhammad Hilal Muhammad Aslam in Khan Younis via precise airstrike; he led a cell that kidnapped Israelis on October 7 and recently advanced terror plans against IDF and civilians. (Source: @New_security8200/203037)

IAF struck Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza; reports indicate strike on a hideout in Rimal neighborhood, Gaza City, with at least one killed and several wounded. (Source: @New_security8200/203033, @New_security8200/203036)
Israeli airstrike destroyed Dar Al-Muttaqin Mosque in central Gaza City. (Source: @presstv/200663)

IDF troops located buried rockets in northern Gaza capable of reaching central Israel and destroyed them; defense establishment assesses Hamas retains additional such rockets and a small number of longer-range rockets. (Source: @New_security8200/203042)

Defense Minister Katz directed IDF to prepare for seizure of another refugee camp following the Jenin/Tulkarem/Nur Shams model of evacuating residents, clearing terror infrastructure, and maintaining permanent presence. (Source: @New_security8200/203031)
An interceptor was erroneously launched toward Lebanese artillery fire; no alerts activated per policy; incident under investigation. (Source: @yediotnews25/133330)
False alarm triggered in Nahal Oz area; IDF confirmed false identification. (Source: @idf_telegram/24752)

IAF struck Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza; separate strike on hideout in Rimal neighborhood, Gaza City, caused at least one death and several injuries. (Source: @New_security8200/203033, @New_security8200/203036)
Israeli airstrike destroyed Dar Al-Muttaqin Mosque in central Gaza City. (Source: @presstv/200663)

IDF uncovered buried rockets in northern Gaza with range to central Israel and destroyed them; Hamas believed to possess more such rockets and a few longer-range projectiles. (Source: @New_security8200/203042)
Ephraim Brigade arrested approximately 30 wanted suspects in seam zone villages suspected of involvement in smuggling illegal infiltrators. (Source: @inon_yttach/9702)

Civil Administration demolished large Palestinian structures in northern Samaria per Smotrich's directive: a 4-story 800 sqm building used for industry and housing, and a 450 sqm commercial/industrial building. (Source: @amitsegal/63441)

Hezbollah-affiliated Islamic Health Organization, part of Hezbollah's executive council, documented operations in pilot village Zutar al-Arabiya in south Lebanon, previously using ambulances to move operatives and weapons. (Source: @inon_yttach/9704)
Explosion reported in Mansouri/Majdal Zoun area between the two villages. (Source: @redlinkleb/33539)
Artillery shelling hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa. (Source: @redlinkleb/33575)
Attack helicopter observed over northern occupied Palestine (south Lebanon). (Source: @redlinkleb/33564)
Interception explosion heard over Metula; incident under investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/203040)

US and Saudi airstrikes targeted official PMU bases in Nineveh, Wasit, and Basra provinces, causing martyrs, injuries, and material damage per PMU statement. (Source: @kianmeli1/90203, @naya_foriraq/86059)
Ammunition depot exploded at PMU/Hashed Al-Shaabi operations command in Basra province. (Source: @shin_persian/8622)
Explosions heard in Al-Deir area of Basra province. (Source: @presstv/200667)
IRGC naval forces seized three oil tankers involved in violations that ignored warnings and continued moving in unsafe, illegal paths. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381643)
Ambulances rushed to scene of US-Saudi strikes in Nineveh province, northern Iraq. (Source: @presstv/200674)

Trump threatened to strike Iran's underground Fordow facility, bridges, and all power plants within one day if nuclear deal fails, stating he prefers to avoid but will execute if necessary. (Source: @VahidOnline/77568)
US official said Iran making excessive demands on Strait of Hormuz, rejected by Oman, US, and international community; talks are for coordination only, not toll collection. (Source: @asafroz/52025)
Crude oil prices jumped 4.4% after Iran's missile strike on US base in Jordan. (Source: @presstv/200665)

Iraqi resistance threatened higher targets inside Saudi Arabia, stating if Yemen's Ansar Allah started with Aramco, Iraqi resistance will start with higher ceiling targets in Saudi Arabia. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381648)
Netanyahu-Trump meeting described as excellent with full partnership on preventing Iranian nuclear weapons. (Source: @inon_yttach/9709)

key_developments: IRGC launched ballistic missiles at US base in Jordan housing CENTCOM headquarters, first Iranian missile strike on US forces since Trump paused attacks; US official confirmed. (Source: @presstv/200676, @inon_yttach/9715)

US and Saudi airstrikes hit PMU bases across Nineveh, Wasit, and Basra provinces, causing casualties and damage; PMU calls it dangerous escalation and violation of Iraqi sovereignty. (Source: @kianmeli1/90203, @naya_foriraq/86059)
IDF eliminated Nukhba commander Muhammad Hilal Muhammad Aslam in Khan Younis who led October 7 kidnapping cell; strike was precise aerial targeting. (Source: @New_security8200/203037)
Israeli troops found and destroyed buried Hamas rockets in northern Gaza with range to central Israel; intelligence assesses more such rockets remain. (Source: @New_security8200/203042)
Defense Minister Katz ordered IDF to prepare seizure of another refugee camp per Jenin model of permanent military presence after clearing terror infrastructure. (Source: @New_security8200/203031)
Hezbollah-linked Islamic Health Organization operating in south Lebanon pilot village Zutar al-Arabiya, previously using ambulances for militant and arms transport. (Source: @inon_yttach/9704)

Trump threatened to destroy Iran's Fordow facility, bridges, and entire power grid within one day if nuclear deal fails, saying 91 million Iranians would lose electricity. (Source: @VahidOnline/77568)
sections.threat_assessment: Iran's direct ballistic missile attack on a US CENTCOM facility in Jordan represents a significant escalation in Iranian willingness to target American military assets, likely testing US resolve after Trump's pause. The coordinated US-Saudi strikes on PMU bases in Iraq signal a joint campaign against Iranian-backed militias, risking wider Iraqi instability. Israel's discovery of buried long-range rockets in northern Gaza indicates Hamas retains strategic strike capability despite months of operations. Hezbollah's institutional presence in Lebanese pilot villages suggests preparation for long-term military entrenchment south of the Litani. Trump's explicit threats against Iranian nuclear and civilian infrastructure raise the probability of US kinetic action if diplomacy fails.
sections.regional_response: Iraqi PMU officially condemned US-Saudi strikes as terrorism and sovereignty violation, promising field assessment and detailed casualty reports. Iranian leadership framed the Jordan strike as legitimate response to US aggression, vowing continued resistance. Israeli political leadership celebrated Netanyahu-Trump alignment on Iranian nuclear red lines. Gulf states face oil price spikes and direct threats from Iraqi factions targeting Saudi infrastructure. Jordan has not officially commented on the missile impact on its territory. The Ukrainian foreign minister's outreach to Iran's Araghchi indicates broader diplomatic engagement amid tensions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The erroneous Israeli interceptor launch toward Lebanese artillery fire reveals potential misidentification risks in the northern sector. Metula interception explosion remains unexplained but may indicate Hezbollah aerial activity. IRGC seizure of three oil tankers demonstrates continued naval enforcement in Gulf waters. Civil Administration demolitions in northern Samaria reflect accelerated Israeli settlement expansion pressure. The Kurdish activist killing by IRGC intelligence underscores internal repression amid external escalation. Monitoring of PMU casualty figures (claims of 7-10 dead) will indicate strike effectiveness and potential for retaliatory attacks on US bases in Iraq and Syria.
